# Docs agent tools

<!-- Generated by tools/agent-tool-docs.mjs from the tool definitions. Do not edit by hand. -->

15 tools, as the model sees them: the name it calls, the description it is given, and every argument its schema accepts.

## `apply_commands`

Execute formatting/structure/batch commands (batchUpdate style, see the command guide in the system prompt): text style, paragraph format, heading level, find & replace, delete/move blocks, list conversion, image properties.

| argument   | type     | required | description                                                              |
| ---------- | -------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `commands` | object[] | yes      | array of commands executed in order; each command is a single-key object |

## `edit_chart`

Edit the data of an existing chart in the document (title/category labels/series names/values). Chart blocks in the block list can be edited; the category count and the number of values per series must match the original chart (data points cannot be added or removed).

| argument          | type           | required | description                                                                       |
| ----------------- | -------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `blockIndex`      | integer        | yes      | block index of the chart                                                          |
| `title`           | string         |          | new title (omit to keep)                                                          |
| `categories`      | string\|null[] |          | new category labels, same length as the original; pass null for positions to keep |
| `series`          | object[]       |          | series to change                                                                  |
| `series[].index`  | integer        | yes      | series index (0-based)                                                            |
| `series[].name`   | string         |          | new series name (omit to keep)                                                    |
| `series[].values` | number\|null[] |          | new values, same length as the original series; pass null for positions to keep   |

## `generate_image`

Generate an illustration from a description and insert it into the document (at the cursor / end of document). Use for diagrams, covers and illustrations that no web image search would find; for a photo of something real, prefer image_search + insert_image.

| argument      | type                                      | required | description                                                                                        |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `prompt`      | string                                    | yes      | what the image should show, in detail: subject, composition, style, colours. English works better. |
| `size`        | `1024x1024` \| `1536x1024` \| `1024x1536` |          | square, landscape or portrait; default square                                                      |
| `transparent` | boolean                                   |          | cut out the background (for logos and icons placed over text)                                      |
| `maxWidthPx`  | integer                                   |          | maximum width in the document (px), default 480                                                    |

## `get_document_context`

Get the latest state of the current document: block list (index|type|content preview), full-text stats (word/character counts) and the current selection. Block indexes change after modifications; call this when you need up-to-date indexes.

No arguments.

## `image_search`

Search for images. Returns a list of image imageUrl entries; after picking one, insert it into the document with insert_image.

| argument     | type    | required | description                                  |
| ------------ | ------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `query`      | string  | yes      | image search keywords (English works better) |
| `maxResults` | integer |          | maximum number of results, default 8         |

## `insert_chart`

Insert a chart (saved as a native Word chart). Data must be real: from the document content or web_search results — do not make up numbers.

| argument          | type                     | required | description                                                                                                            |
| ----------------- | ------------------------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `kind`            | `bar` \| `line` \| `pie` | yes      | chart type                                                                                                             |
| `title`           | string                   |          | chart title                                                                                                            |
| `categories`      | string[]                 | yes      | category (x axis / sector) labels                                                                                      |
| `series`          | object[]                 | yes      | data series; values has the same length as categories, use null for missing data. Pie charts use only the first series |
| `series[].name`   | string                   |          |                                                                                                                        |
| `series[].values` | number\|null[]           | yes      |                                                                                                                        |
| `afterBlockIndex` | integer                  |          | insert after this block index; -1 = start of document; omitted = after the block containing the cursor                 |

## `insert_content`

Insert new content at a given position (restricted HTML, may contain multiple blocks). For writing/continuing/generating new content; to rewrite existing content use replace_blocks.

| argument          | type    | required | description                                                                                            |
| ----------------- | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `html`            | string  | yes      | restricted HTML fragment to insert                                                                     |
| `afterBlockIndex` | integer |          | insert after this block index; -1 = start of document; omitted = after the block containing the cursor |

## `insert_image`

Download a direct image link (an imageUrl from image_search) and insert it into the document (at the cursor / end of document).

| argument     | type    | required | description                     |
| ------------ | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------- |
| `url`        | string  | yes      | direct image link               |
| `maxWidthPx` | integer |          | maximum width (px), default 480 |

## `manage_notes`

Footnotes and endnotes. action=list returns the existing ones with their ids; add inserts a reference marker at the cursor and creates the note; edit and delete take an id from list (deleting renumbers the rest). Use a footnote for an aside or a source on the page it belongs to, an endnote when the document collects them at the end — not for content that belongs in the body.

| argument | type                                  | required | description                        |
| -------- | ------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `action` | `list` \| `add` \| `edit` \| `delete` | yes      |                                    |
| `kind`   | `footnote` \| `endnote`               |          | default footnote                   |
| `text`   | string                                |          | add / edit: the note text          |
| `id`     | string                                |          | edit / delete: id from action=list |

## `manage_sources`

Bibliography sources. action=list returns them with their tags; add registers one. A source is only worth adding when the document cites it — pair it with a citation in the text. tag is the short key you cite by (e.g. "Wang2024"); type is Word's source type: Book, JournalArticle, InternetSite, Report, ConferenceProceedings.

| argument    | type                        | required | description |
| ----------- | --------------------------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `action`    | `list` \| `add` \| `remove` | yes      |             |
| `tag`       | string                      |          |             |
| `type`      | string                      |          |             |
| `author`    | string                      |          |             |
| `title`     | string                      |          |             |
| `year`      | string                      |          |             |
| `publisher` | string                      |          |             |
| `url`       | string                      |          |             |

## `read_attachment`

Read the text content of an attachment (parsed locally). Long files are paged: read offset=0 first, then decide whether to continue based on the returned total character count.

| argument | type    | required | description                                         |
| -------- | ------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `index`  | integer | yes      | attachment index (0-based, see the attachment list) |
| `offset` | integer |          | start character position, default 0                 |

## `read_blocks`

Read the full content of a block range (restricted HTML). Previews in the block list are truncated; you must read the full original text with this tool before rewriting.

| argument          | type    | required | description                            |
| ----------------- | ------- | -------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `startBlockIndex` | integer | yes      | start block index (0-based, inclusive) |
| `endBlockIndex`   | integer | yes      | end block index (inclusive)            |

## `replace_blocks`

Replace a block range with new content (restricted HTML). For rewriting/translating/condensing/expanding existing content; the new block count may differ from the old.

| argument          | type    | required | description                            |
| ----------------- | ------- | -------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `startBlockIndex` | integer | yes      | start block index (0-based, inclusive) |
| `endBlockIndex`   | integer | yes      | end block index (inclusive)            |
| `html`            | string  | yes      | replacement restricted HTML fragment   |

## `set_watermark`

Set or remove the page watermark — the diagonal text behind the body, for DRAFT / CONFIDENTIAL and the like. Pass an empty string to remove it. One or two words; a watermark is a status marker, not a notice.

| argument | type   | required | description                      |
| -------- | ------ | -------- | -------------------------------- |
| `text`   | string | yes      | watermark text; empty removes it |

## `web_search`

Search the web for textual information (references/data/facts). Use when you need up-to-date information or are unsure about a fact. Returns titles/links/snippets.

| argument     | type    | required | description                          |
| ------------ | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `query`      | string  | yes      | search keywords                      |
| `maxResults` | integer |          | maximum number of results, default 6 |
